result:
Hop 11 done: Angular 18.2.14 → 19.2.25.

- `ng update @angular/core@19 @angular/cli@19` ran clean; its migration added `standalone: false` to the seven NgModule-declared components (standalone is the v19 default). Also pulled TypeScript ~5.8.3 and zone.js ~0.15.1.
- Bumped @ngrx/* 18.1.1 → 19.2.1 (not in the hop file, but NgRx 18 peer-pins Angular 18). Its schematic runner crashed mid-run after writing package.json, so no NgRx migrations executed — verified none were needed for this code.
- One hand fix: `BrowserModule.withServerTransition()` was removed in v19, and its compile error invalidated the whole `imports` array, cascading into ~15 misleading template errors. Replaced with plain `BrowserModule` + an explicit `APP_ID` provider keeping the id `ng-cli-universal`.
- Declined both optional migrations (application builder, provide-initializer).

Checks: `npm install` pass (verified from a wiped `node_modules`, no `--force`), `npm run build` pass, `npm run build:ssr` pass, `npm run test` still fails on the pre-existing `styles.css` path bug in angular.json's test target — identical to baseline. Report written to `.upgrade/reports/11-v18-to-v19.json`; no commit made, per the rules.
